purpose: Add per-cell/cycle provenance without changing old grid economics
rules: Exact original replay copy into new diagnostic module; only extra event records/cell IDs/reset-reason metadata, no modifying frozen source or original artifacts. No strategy branch/cost/fill/timing changes.
identity: Require complete original economic fills and every daily NAV exactly equal, fee/turnover/exposure unchanged. One emitted trace event per actual fill; owner inventory sum matches account; cash and total realized+unrealized reconcile.
ownership: Each buy creates net-BTC cost lot inside immutable reset:cell owner. Limit sell matches FIFO within SAME owner. Aggregate reset/terminal sales allocate sold net BTC proportionally over all owner quantities including old dust, then FIFO within owner, final residual allocated deterministically. Allocation is attribution, no additional broker fill rounding.
dust: Never discard unclosed subminimum residual; retain old owner after reset. Completion flag only quantity <=1e-12; dust is not a certified full profitable cycle.
reset_reason: Record at decision from then-known close/bounds/clock: initial,lower_bound,upper_bound,scheduled30d; multiple flags retained. Execution later carries fixed decision metadata. No causal claim about reset benefit from sale PnL.
outputs: sell reason x causal reset flags aggregation
independent saved NAV and economic fill comparison
limits: Known historical diagnostic. Inherits original zero-volume and OHLC crossing/queue assumptions; no execution certification or trading authorization. No states selected by outcomes.
